## Root orb-250-process-events: Accept valid native output partitions

Kind: group
Project: orbit
Parent: null
Depends on: none
Children, in strict order: orb-250-partition-regressions

Objective: Process-output tests accept every valid OS read partition while still detecting lost/reordered bytes, stream mixing and oversized events.

Scope:

- In: NativeProcessRunner output-event regression tests and their local process fixtures.
- Out: production process-runner behavior, output limits, deployment streaming protocols, Schedule tests, WireGuard fixtures, and test-runner dependencies.

Shared context:

- The existing test `emits ordered single-stream events at the exact byte boundary` in `apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunnerTest.php` requires lengths [16384] or [16384,1]. Those exact partitions depend on OS reads. Preserve both 16,384/16,385-byte cases, native child execution, full ordered bytes per stream and the existing result-truncation checks.
- `apps/gateway/app/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunner.php` flushes events after each read iteration. `docs/reference/deployments.md`, “Read output and failures,” promises at most 16,384 bytes per event, not fixed lengths. Production code is a read-only reference.
- The existing `processFactory` seam and test-local `NativeProcessRunnerCompletedProcess` demonstrate controlled process reads without changing production. Deterministic coverage must exercise the real runner with distinguishable, order-sensitive stream content, including a read exceeding the event limit. Repeating one identical byte cannot detect within-stream reordering.
- The retained 50-attempt native observation has 32 old-partition mismatches across 100 streams, but all bytes/bounds and exits are valid. Its script exits zero after observation, not after strict acceptance assertions. Do not reuse that exit as a candidate test pass.

issue.title: Make process-output tests independent of pipe read partitions
issue.description:
Gateway process-output regression tests accept every valid operating-system read partition while still detecting byte loss, reordering, stream mixing, and oversized events. On main `317de2b630f7e8febdc3f2a25a664e10d14a6beb`, the current test sometimes rejects complete output because it requires one particular chunk split.

* In: NativeProcessRunner output-event regression tests and their local process fixtures.
* Out: Production process-runner behavior, output limits, deployment streaming protocols, Schedule tests, WireGuard fixtures, and test-runner dependencies.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Native output observations at 16,384 and 16,385 bytes per stream pass for every valid read partition, with each event nonempty and at most 16,384 bytes and each stream retaining its exact ordered bytes. Proof: affected Gateway TIA tests exercising the existing native process boundary and inspecting per-stream event content and bounds.
- [ ] Deterministic regression cases detect a lost or reordered byte, a wrong stream attribution, and an event above the existing size limit without depending on host pipe capacity or scheduling. Proof: affected Gateway TIA tests with controlled process-read observations and a retained bounded negative-control check.
- [ ] A retained repeat of the original native process observation preserves all output without requiring fixed chunk lengths; the exact-boundary coverage remains present rather than being skipped or replaced with a pass-on-retry policy. Proof: affected Gateway TIA evidence plus a bounded repeated local observation documenting bytes, event bounds, exits, and actual partitions.

Implemented ORB-250 task orb-250-partition-regressions as one uncommitted, test-local change. Native boundary assertions now accept every valid read partition while enforcing nonempty bounded events and exact ordered bytes. Added controlled real-runner reads, four deterministic negative controls, and a strict 50-attempt native observation mode. The exact tree is ready for independent review.

Binding: discovery flow; base/HEAD 317de2b630f7e8febdc3f2a25a664e10d14a6beb on branch orb-250. Incus is not required by the approved package and no topology was acquired. Final status has exactly one modified path: apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunnerTest.php. No production, protocol, limit, harness, maintained-doc, dependency, Schedule, or WireGuard file changed. Final file SHA-256 cab77c73626c4037880ce1d08268f6e1eb246d440834d96ce0e0a31c0c7782fd; retained full diff /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v4-submission.diff, SHA-256 90b3e013e8b99aab0fa25cb920d85262b46c16dcd395e03f7908f6e859f4de9b.

T1 / V1: cwd /fast/worktrees/orbit/orb-250/apps/gateway. Isolated `composer test:affected -- --log-junit=/tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v1-test-affected-final.xml` exited 0. TIA selected only tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunnerTest.php from the one changed file; 16 tests and 54 assertions passed. JUnit records both native rows (`exact event limit` 16,384 and `one byte above event limit` 16,385), with zero errors/failures/skips. Each row runs a native PHP child through NativeProcessRunner, verifies every event is nonempty and <=16,384 bytes, verifies concatenated stdout/stderr equal the exact inputs, and preserves successful exit/full result/no-truncation assertions. Neighboring tail, cancellation, timeout, completed-result, protected-input, and sink-error cases also passed. Logs: /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v1-test-affected-final.log (SHA-256 29f783be458796cc08b7312400f1822ef18da48f2a97827080197f3bf2fc51d0) and /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v1-test-affected-final.xml (SHA-256 d325cb3094e5d3557ad394dfa9d323b90873912c6817e2baed758ab0e0bb1ed0).

T2 / V1+V2: same Gateway cwd and isolation. V1 JUnit records the controlled real-runner split case and all four negative-control rows as executed and passing. The controlled Symfony Process returns distinguishable, order-sensitive stdout/stderr reads, including a 16,385-byte read that the real runner splits. Direct bounded check `/usr/bin/php8.5 tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunnerTest.php negative-controls` exited 0 after validating the baseline and rejecting lost byte, reordered byte, wrong stream attribution, and oversized event corruptions (4/4). T3 / V3: same Gateway cwd and isolation. `/usr/bin/php8.5 tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Processes/NativeProcessRunnerTest.php observe-native` exited 0. It ran 50 native children with separate 16,385-byte stdout/stderr writes and a five-second timeout per child. All 50 were valid: exact bytes/hashes, nonempty events, <=16,384-byte events, child exit 0, and result truncated=false. Recorded stdout partitions: [16384,1] in 50 attempts. Recorded stderr partitions: [16384,1] in 28, [8192,8193] in 21, and [8192,8192,1] in 1. No later success can erase an earlier failure because final exit is zero only when valid_attempts equals 50. Log: /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v3-native-observation-post-pint.jsonl, SHA-256 0a9063f3507f91273c13842c0b9fecdea902009bbae9529940d320a9fc15add2.

T4 / V4: cwd /fast/worktrees/orbit/orb-250/apps/gateway. Isolated `composer check` exited 0: guidance 12 tests/267 assertions, Rector dry-run OK, Pint check 1,105 files PASS, Larastan no errors. Log: /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T/v4-composer-check-final.log, SHA-256 73b5254b2cd0891ae82cac581658ffbb61235bb534311519b7c12707e6b8abc8. Full diff was inspected and contains only the named test file. `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` had exited 0 before final V1-V4; the retained CLI usage notes in that test file document both bounded verification modes. No warning suppression, skip, retry, or pass-on-retry logic was added.

Isolation/preflight: all PHP/Pest/Composer acceptance runs used `env -i`, PHP 8.5, unchanged HOME=/home/nckrtl, private ORBIT_HOME/TMPDIR/Laravel storage/bootstrap/Composer/XDG paths under /tmp/orb250-run6.CWMj3T, DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory:, and empty DB_URL.
